retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, low-key male portrait featuring dramatic side-lighting and classic serif typography positioned in the upper right corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a man with dark curly hair and a mustache, emerging from deep shadows. The lighting is directional, illuminating only half of the face and creating a stark contrast against a black background. The composition is anchored by a two-line serif text block in the upper right and a small technical logo in the bottom right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject face positioned on the left third with gaze directed toward the viewer
Typography balanced in the negative space on the right
Deep black background merging with the unlit side of the subject
Red accent color in the clothing providing a focal point at the base
coreInvariants: Warm skin tones against a cool black void

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale head and shoulders portrait occupying the left two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The illuminated eye and bridge of the nose serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright side of the face, across the dark void to the text in the upper right, then down to the red shirt collar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space on the right side of the frame.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall saturation, except for the localized red accent.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thicks and thins
characterSpecificRedesigns: Small caps used for specific emphasis
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying weights or cases.
graphicDevices: Subtle orange drop shadow on text
Technical logo in bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic high-contrast serif structure and availability.
Provides the sturdy, bracketed serifs seen in the reference.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key studio portrait of a man with 80s styling, using a single hard light source from the side to create deep chiaroscuro shadows against a pure black background. Add heavy film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Typeset the name in a bold high-contrast serif font in the upper right corner, right-aligned, with a very thin orange-red drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the right side of the face completely in shadow?
Is the text right-aligned in the upper quadrant?
Is there a visible red accent near the bottom center?
Does the image have a grainy, analog film texture?

adjustableVariables: Ratio of light to shadow on the face
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the individual
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the shadow side of the face is nearly black
Verify the text is a classic serif font
Check for the presence of a subtle warm drop shadow on text
Confirm the composition feels weighted to the left
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait(Low-Key + Side-Lit) + Background(Solid Black) + Typography(Upper-Right + Serif + Right-Aligned) = 80s Soul Aesthetic
